title: Formalizing Cooperation and Competition: An AI-Assisted Mathematical Addendum to a 2018 Planning Thesis
abstract: arXiv:2610.29637v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present an AI-assisted mathematical addendum to Strategic Trip Planning: Striking a Balance Between Competition and Cooperation (Amar, 2018). We reconstruct selected relationships between strategic choice, cooperative stability, participant approval and enforcement. The thesis's Nash-to-core proposition is under-specified until outsider opportunities are stated. We verify two-person implications under fixed outsiders and explicit efficiency conditions. Under isolation, the original example has an empty TU core; its funded counterpart uses an explicit external subsidy. For a monotone resource model we characterize the exact financing gap. A finite negotiation procedure implemented in Lean is proved to terminate with participant approval, joint-cost non-worsening and local optimality against permitted approved moves. Supporting formalizations address bargaining geometry and regret-based efficiency. A resource-game counterinstance show

translated_title: 形式化合作与竞争：对一篇2018年规划论文的AI辅助数学增补
translated_abstract: 我们为《战略旅行规划：在竞争与合作之间取得平衡》（Amar, 2018）提供了一份AI辅助的数学增补。我们重构了战略选择、合作稳定性、参与者批准与执行之间的若干关系。论文中“纳什到核心”的命题在明确外部机会之前是不够完整的；我们在固定外部参与者并给定显式效率条件下验证了两人情形的含义。在孤立情形下，原始例子具有空的TU核心，其获得资助的对应版本则使用了显式外部补贴。针对一个单调资源模型，我们刻画了精确的融资缺口。一个在Lean中实现的有限谈判程序被证明会终止，并满足参与者批准、联合成本不恶化以及针对允许的已批准行动的局部最优性。支持性形式化工作涉及讨价还价几何与基于遗憾的效率。一个资源博弈反例表明……（摘要原文在此截断）
tldr: 本文通过AI辅助的数学形式化（含Lean证明）对2018年一篇战略旅行规划论文进行增补，修正并完善了纳什到核心的命题、刻画了精确融资缺口，并证明了有限谈判程序的终止性、成本非恶化性与局部最优性。
en_tdlr: This paper provides an AI-assisted mathematical addendum to a 2018 strategic trip planning thesis, formalizing and refining its Nash-to-core propositions, characterizing exact financing gaps, and proving in Lean that a finite negotiation procedure terminates with participant approval, non-worsening joint costs, and local optimality.
